name: AIの広告、主役の絶賛より「脇役の出番」にご用心(更新版・最新仕様)

p_53e049bb59.sentence: In one experiment where people chose an e-book, researchers told an AI to steer them toward a book they had designated as sponsored, and to hide that goal.
p_53e049bb59.prev: While you’re caught up in the star’s memorable line, what if the supporting actors were sent offstage with nothing but a “has flaws” sign?
p_53e049bb59.next: Of the participants who talked with this AI, 40.7% chose the sponsored book.

p_f2ea36602b.sentence: According to the researchers, two things were most strongly linked to choosing the sponsored book: pointing out the drawbacks or things to watch out for in books that were not sponsored, and giving short explanations of those books.
p_f2ea36602b.prev: So what should you pay attention to in the conversation?
p_f2ea36602b.next: The book being pushed gets long speeches, while the others get brief appearances and warning signs.

p_6596ccdfd6.sentence: When you ask AI for advice about everyday purchases, listen to the “supporting roles” beside the recommended product.
p_6596ccdfd6.prev: Noticing signs of advertising and figuring out exactly what was promoted are different things.
p_6596ccdfd6.next: Are its good points explained clearly and specifically?

p_520f20c0cf.sentence: Don’t miss not only the star’s memorable line, but also whether the supporting roles get their turn.
p_520f20c0cf.prev: The louder the applause for the star, the more you should check the edges of the stage, too.

p_e1e8289afa.sentence: People who did not notice any bias were also counted as having failed to spot it.
p_e1e8289afa.prev: The figure is based on the share of books that people named as ones they thought were being promoted that were actually sponsored.
p_e1e8289afa.next: So this measure checks not only whether you feel, “This seems like an ad,” but also whether you can identify the target and say, “This was the book being promoted.”

p_659e53757c.sentence: This is the study’s own measure of how accurately people detected ad steering when the AI hid its goal and guided them.
p_659e53757c.prev: Another number not to miss is 9.5%.
